assumptions.statement: All spatial layers are generated from the repository's provisional rough boundary and provisional key-area polygons inferred from the official announcement's textual extents and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: Layers and metrics cannot be used as official redlines, approval basis, or precise-area conclusions; full-chain recomputation is required when official polygons are released.
assumptions.trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA GeoJSON released by the organizer

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: floor_area_ratio and related control metrics are marked unknown; building scale suggestions are conceptual frameworks pending official regulatory conditions.
assumptions.trigger: Official regulatory planning conditions or design brief attachments

assumptions.statement: Existing-building survey, ownership boundaries, and parcel-level conditions along the belt are not available in public materials; retain/renovate/demolish suggestions are method-level classifications, not parcel conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are illustrative and labelled confidence=low; demolition/renovation conclusions require professional field verification.

assumptions.statement: Rail-station integration schemes (Wudaokou, Qinghua East Road West, Dazhongsi) and road micro-circulation proposals are directional; station layouts, road redlines, and utility conditions await official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Road centerlines are schematic (confidence=low); four-quadrant connectivity and station integration require engineering review.
assumptions.trigger: Official road redlines and station engineering documents

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, distributed energy, edge-compute infrastructure, flood-control (Qinghe blue line), and fire conditions are not confirmed; blue-green proposals are subject to ecological and engineering review.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and blue-line proposals are conceptual; riverfront designs require flood-control confirmation.
assumptions.trigger: Official municipal, blue-line, and flood-control documents

assumptions.statement: The 'herringbone switchback' (人字京张) concept is a design metaphor derived from the Jing-Zhang Railway's Badaling switchback line; it is used as organizational logic and narrative, not as a physical infrastructure claim.
assumptions.impact: The concept informs spatial structure, naming, logo direction, landmarks, and event systems as conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
